race.verdict: THORNEYLANDS was well suited by the step up in trip making his handicap debut when joining the leader on the line at Kelso in May and he is taken to score again with further improvement to come. The main danger could be Presentandcorrect . THORNEYLANDS (IRE) PRESENTANDCORRECT (IRE) BOLD LIGHT (IRE)
